notes: CompanyToken is the Company.MD (COMD) ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 COMD once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no administrative powers, further minting, transfer taxes or application contracts. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
